summary:
**Worked:** Five brothers, one ship drew 1,994 Threads views and 21 comments (Reach 7.74, the second best card ever); the Ark Royal Name This drew 1,407; the Tirpitz and Moselle videos traveled on Threads (1,362 and 707), and the Moselle Reel drew 841 on Facebook.

**Didn't:** every 8 a.m. Story card from 11 to 15 Nov drew only 38 to 87 Threads views, while the noon video on the same story drew far more; YouTube halved for the week (4,161 views against 9,250).

**Patterns:** combat and turning points out reach diplomacy and machines; Spec Sheets reach less than Story cards; Home Front reaches fewer people but draws the strongest Response.

**Tests:** C (shorter Story Cards) still has no Story Card to read; D (no hashtags on X) starts 22 Nov. No new test proposed.

**Reach report:** only one post per platform from the five post days is old enough; first real reading 24 Nov.

**Decisions:** none new. Your Name This on Instagram answer (end it) needs the Name This doc updated in a Project chat; your three Code Room vetoes are applied.
